description: Catalog of CI/CD failure modes, diagnosis rules, fixtures, and remediation workflows

failureModes.symptom: Release verification step fails with SHA256 checksum discrepancy
failureModes.remediation: Regenerate SHA256SUMS.txt with `sha256sum * > SHA256SUMS.txt` after rebuilding all platform artifacts.

failureModes.symptom: Packaging fails because expected installer or archive is missing from release directory
failureModes.remediation: Check CI build matrix artifacts download step and ensure all platform target jobs finished successfully.

failureModes.symptom: SHA256SUMS.txt contains duplicate file entries or hashes
failureModes.remediation: Deduplicate SHA256SUMS.txt ensuring one canonical line per artifact.

failureModes.symptom: CI or pre-commit hook reports 'missing record updates' (check-records.sh exit 1)
failureModes.cause: Substantive files (crates, scripts, CI, skills) changed without updating both feature_list.json and claude-progress.md
failureModes.remediation: Add an entry to claude-progress.md under current session and update feature_list.json last_updated timestamp and feature evidence array.

failureModes.symptom: cargo clippy fails under `-D warnings` policy
failureModes.cause: Compiler warnings in workspace code or tests
failureModes.remediation: Fix warning at source; never suppress or weaken `-D warnings` policy per GUARDRAILS.md.
